questionText: His knowledge of the subject was excellent but his classroom performance was _______.
explanation:
Step 1: Analyze sentence structure.
The coordinating conjunction 'but' is used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what has already been mentioned.

Step 2: Determine tone of the sentence parts.
The first part, 'His knowledge of the subject was excellent', expresses a clear positive evaluation. Therefore, the phrase following 'but' must express a contrasting, negative evaluation.

Step 3: Evaluate the options.
• (A) extremely poor: Negative evaluation, providing the correct contrast.
• (B) good: Positive evaluation.
• (C) desirable: Positive evaluation.
• (D) praiseworthy: Positive evaluation.

Thus, extremely poor is the correct choice.
